TEXT:
[FI] With the explanation session coming to an end, we 
headed for the clubroom again.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Showing up right after I texted you, well aren't 
you brimming with energy?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? A text...

[FI] Ah, she's right. There's a text message notification 
on my phone.

[FI] "We'll have a meeting for the production of a new 
game, in preparation for the upcoming Cultural 
Festival, so please gather at the clubroom" ...Huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Actually, I only just read the text. Today was just 
pure coincidence...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ehhh? Really!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Geez. Please give your club activities some thought. 
I know it's the long-awaited summer holidays, you 
want to be lovey-dovey with Onii-chan, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] As if. I've been studying for my exams, so I can't 
show up as much!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Studying alone with Onii-chan, I'll bet?

[FI] Don't stare at me with those eyes full of hope. 
They're dazzling, but deep inside is rotten beyond 
belief.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Behind closed doors, teaching each other every 
detail, whatever could you two be studying, Senpai, 
you dog! Fuhihihihi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Enough with that creepy laugh, seriously...

[FI] It might seem unbelievable, but in her brain lies an 
image of Kouhei and I being lovers.

[FI] She's the so-called "Fujoshi", but coupling your 
own brother and your club's senior together, that's 
not normal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, is everyone else coming back today?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Club President and Makabe-senpai are already in 
the clubroom. I sent Gokou-san a text already, so 
she'll be arriving soon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Club Pres and Makabe-Senpai... They keep hanging 
out in the clubroom, even though it's the summer 
holidays. Don't you think they're a little too close?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Oh my, is it because their affection is way too 
deep, or that the high school boy's sexual desires 
are scary, or-

[FI] ...What's this girl going on about, acting all proud? 
The scary one is your brain.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That aside, a new game, huh. I don't think there's 
much I can really do to help out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I believe you have the talent to manage a project. 
I'm hoping you can do something along those lines.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Managing a project? You mean stuff like... preparing 
a schedule?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yes. As it is now, everyone in the club is eccentric 
and works without stopping, so we're helpless 
without someone to manage it all.
[FI] You're at the top of that list of eccentrics.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Aren't you better at management, compared to 
me?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I want to focus on the game contents this time. 
That's why I'm counting on you to manage this 
project well♪
[FI] Feels like an unpleasant chore instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Stuff like allocating tasks, deciding "What game 
should we make", making decisions after our club 
discussion. That's our objective today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...You're putting a lot of responsibility on someone 
who rarely shows up for club.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Oh you. I have faith that you'll be able to handle 
this well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey now, don't expect too much.

[FI] We continued talking while walking down the hall, 
just when we were about to enter-
[FI] Sena's cellphone went off.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] ...I wonder who it is, maybe Onii-chan? Lately, he's 
been sending a text every hour.

[FI] Akagi's already that much of a siscon. It's as if 
they're a couple in a new relationship.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hm? What's up? Is it a harassing text from Akagi?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] No, it isn't Onii-chan... it's Gokou-san. She's taking care 
of her sister and can't make it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's too bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] *sigh* With Gokou-san gone, there's no point in 
splitting up the tasks. To begin with, the club's 
games were practically all done by both of us...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Come on, don't say that. The president's here, isn't 
he? Even he can make games, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] The games he makes reveals his mischievous 
nature well, extremely challenging shooting games 
that only he can appreciate.

[FI] That's pretty harsh... Well, what she said of the 
president's games is accurate, so I can't defend 
him in any way, but still...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I-In any case, let's just have a discussion with 
whoever that's here. Okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry for being late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Wait... There's no one here![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] That's not possible, those two should be waiting in 
here...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...They're gone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, look at this.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] They left... a letter?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Yo, you guys! We were having a stupid discussion, 
then suddenly an incredible urge to visit the beach 
overcame us, so we headed off to check things out.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] Senachi will take my place and handle the rest. Best 
regards!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
[FI] P.S. If we end up taking photos of girls in swimsuits, 
we'll share it with you so rest assured, Kousaka~

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] ...Those damn otaku...! They're practically shut-ins, yet 
now they're acting as if they're youthful teens...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A-ahahahaha... ahaha... ha...

[FI] No wonder she's fuming! She made such an honest 
effort to organize a meeting, yet no one is here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So... What now?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] "What now" you ask? We can't get anything done 
with just the two of us! We're postponing this 
meeting!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] How dare those two just...! Skipping club activities, 
going to the beach...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Seriously, just how close are those two... Guys and 
their swimming trunks? They're practically naked...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] And in those trunks, the club president making out 
with Makabe-senpai... fufufu, ufufufufu...①

[FI] Great, Sena's immersed in her rotten delusions 
again...
